rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 1992).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 1992 as 'Dusky Dancer'.
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 1998 as 'Dusky Dancer'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Mild fragrance. 18 to 22 petals. Average diameter 2". Medium, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, compact, upright, well-branched. Medium, medium green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 47" to 4'11" (120 to 150cm). Width: 1' to 15" (30 to 40cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, garden or shrub. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
